Subject: Senior PM candidate — suggested seniority & comp band

Tessa / hiring committee,

Quick context: we wrapped loop interviews for Renee Carter (product manager candidate) yesterday. Strong signals on customer-facing product sense + cross-functional influence. Hiring manager recommends a Senior PM hire — role will own a mid-size component and mentor two L3 PMs.

Open question: where to place her for offer calibration. Recruiter submitted comp data and comp-band-proposal attached — covers comparable internal bands, external market median (SF), and proposed level. My initial read: could be either L5 (Senior) or L6 (Staff-ish) depending on title scope; I lean toward L5 with a stretch comp package to secure her.

Proposed ask:
- Base: $185,000
- Bonus/target: 15%
- RSU: $140k 4-year vests (standard cadence) + 1st-year sign-on of $25k to bridge comp.

Please review the attached comp-band-proposal.pdf and ReneeC_resume.pdf. Specifically looking for:
- Agreement on L5 vs L6 placement
- Any concerns from total comp equity mix
- If approved for L6, we'll need a headcount reclassification and director sign-off.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Product Recruiting
Redwood Inference

Attachments: comp-band-proposal.pdf (pdf), ReneeC_resume.pdf (pdf)

Thanks Marcus — nice summary. A couple of quick notes from the hiring-side POV:
- Renee looks like a strong match for a *senior* individual contributor (L5). She doesn't have the org-level product ownership we normally expect for L6/Staff.
- I'm comfortable with base in the $175–190k band; the $185k you proposed sits well.
- I want to avoid creating an expectation for promotion-to-staff in the offer language. If we hire as L5, we should set explicit growth expectations in the onboarding plan.

Laura / Evelyn — any objections to making an L5 offer with the proposed RSU + sign-on? If we think there's a retention risk that requires L6, flag it explicitly (we'll need headcount/band changes).

I'll loop in PeopleOps if we need a band exception or formal headcount reclass.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Product Recruiting
Redwood Inference
